mapper.sql: ID, PARTNER_ID, LIST_TYPE, LIST_REASON, RISK_LEVEL, BUSINESS_SCOPE, RESTRICTION_DETAILS, EVIDENCE_MATERIALS, REVIEW_PERIOD, NEXT_REVIEW_DATE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRE_DATE, APPROVAL_USER, APPROVAL_TIME, REMOVAL_REASON, REMOVAL_USER, REMOVAL_TIME, STATUS, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, VERSION_NO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_LIST WHERE PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_LIST WHERE LIST_TYPE = #{listType} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_LIST WHERE RISK_LEVEL = #{riskLevel} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) as totalRisks, SUM(CASE WHEN LIST_TYPE = 'WHITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as whiteListCount, SUM(CASE WHEN LIST_TYPE = 'BLACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as blackListCount, SUM(CASE WHEN LIST_TYPE = 'GRAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as grayListCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highRiskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mediumRiskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lowRiskCount FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_LIST WHERE STATUS = '1'
SELECT FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_LIST WHERE STATUS = '1' AND (LIST_TYPE = 'BLACK' OR RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' OR NEXT_REVIEW_DATE <= CURRENT_DATE + 7) ORDER BY RISK_LEVEL DESC, CREATE_TIME DESC
